title: Rollback is a promote of a prior version id
asA: operator responding to a bad release
iWant: the same promote workflow to take a prior version id and route production to it
soThat: rollback carries the same audit shape and post-promote verification as every other ship

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Deploy Adapter's `listVersions` verb returns the recent version history with the currently-serving version id marked; the `promote` workflow's `versionId` input accepts any id present in this list.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator on a machine authenticated to the deploy vendor
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator invokes `deployAdapter.listVersions()` and picks a prior id P then triggers the `promote` workflow with `versionId=P`
acceptanceCriteria.then: `listVersions` returns a list containing P with the currently-serving flag on the correct entry; the `promote` run succeeds; the deploy-log record names P as `promotedVersionId` and the prior currently-serving id as `previousVersionId`

acceptanceCriteria.description: The project's source tree contains no separately-authored `rollback` verb that bypasses the `promote` workflow, the deploy-log record, or the post-promote verifier.
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan searches for verbs named `rollback` (or synonyms `revert`, `undoPromote`) that spawn the vendor CLI or issue a vendor deploy call outside the Deploy Adapter
acceptanceCriteria.then: no such verb exists; every rollback path routes through the `promote` workflow and the Deploy Adapter

acceptanceCriteria.description: A rollback promote runs the served-surface verifier against the production URL and fails the run if any probe path fails, exactly like a forward promote.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a promote of a prior version id P that intentionally fails a probe (a probe path P is missing from the older bundle)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the workflow exits non-zero with `PROMOTE_VERIFY_FAILED`; the failing probe path and the response status are recorded; the deploy-log record does not mark the release successful
